notes.title: Demo Update: Improved UX
notes.content:
Hey Heroes, Happy New Year 2023! 

To celebrate we released an update to the demo.
Major focus is the improved UX, but there's also new monsters, cards and progression.
Hope you enjoy it. Let us know in the forums.

Follow the development on [url=https://twitter.com/fad]Twitter[/url]!
